pt-BR.title: Brasil vence a Suíça e avança na Copa Davis
pt-BR.summary: Dupla Orlando Luz e Rafael Matos fecha o confronto por 3 a 0 e garante o Brasil nos Qualifiers.
paragraphs: Orlando Luz e Rafael Matos venceram Jakub Paul e Dominic Stricker por 2 sets a 0, no Rio de Janeiro, e fizeram o terceiro ponto do Brasil contra a Suíça. As parciais foram 7/6(1) e 6/2, em 1h45 de partida.

João Fonseca e Gustavo Heide já haviam vencido os jogos de simples na sexta-feira. Com o 3 a 0, o Brasil avançou no Grupo Mundial 1 e garantiu vaga nos Qualifiers, com chance de buscar a fase final em 2027.

en.title: Brazil beat Switzerland to advance in the Davis Cup
en.summary: Orlando Luz and Rafael Matos sealed a 3–0 tie and sent Brazil into the Qualifiers.
paragraphs: Orlando Luz and Rafael Matos beat Switzerland's Jakub Paul and Dominic Stricker in straight sets in Rio de Janeiro, earning Brazil's third point. The score was 7–6(1), 6–2 after 1 hour and 45 minutes.

João Fonseca and Gustavo Heide had already won the singles matches on Friday. The 3–0 result moves Brazil on from World Group I and secures a place in the Qualifiers, with a chance to reach the 2027 finals stage.
